title: Local decision connected with evidence and interpretation
scenario: A learner encounters a real-life situation where evidence and interpretation and people and institutions pull the decision in different directions. The learner must use evidence and reasoning rather than guesswork.
tasks: Identify the decision to be made.

title: Transfer case: change over time
scenario: A new situation resembles an idea from 'Understanding the Weather' but includes a different condition. Learners must decide whether the chapter concept still applies.
tasks: Decide what transfers and what does not.
